title: Warnings
description: Warning ladder (a role and an action per level), expiry, issuing and revoking — the bot carries it out on Discord.
userIdHint: On Discord: right-click the member → Copy User ID
emptyText: There are no warnings in this view.
revokeText: The warning is revoked (it stays in the history); the bot updates the ladder role and sends a DM.

server.notAssignable: The bot can’t assign @{role} (it must be below the bot’s role).
server.dangerous: Only a server admin can set a role with dangerous permissions.
server.badTimeout: A timeout must be between 1 and {max} minutes.
server.adminAction: Only a server admin can put kick or ban on the ladder.

bl.title: Blacklist
bl.description: The bot bans the member for the given time (or permanently) and lifts it automatically on expiry — even if they’re not on the server right now.
bl.modeBan: The bot bans for the given time — lifted on expiry.
bl.removeText: They can join the server again (with ban mode the bot also unbans them).

reasonHint: The member gets it in a DM.
clearText: All their active warnings are revoked and the bot removes the ladder roles.

ladder.title: Warning ladder
ladder.text: The level follows the number of active warnings: the member gets that level’s role (the bot removes the other ladder roles), and the level’s action runs when they move up. With more warnings than levels, the highest applies.
ladder.empty: No ladder — the old threshold setting applies (timeout at every Nth warning). Add a level!
ladder.messagePlaceholder: Message at this level (optional) — sent in DM and to the warning log. Placeholders: '{user}', '{count}', '{level}', '{server}'
